sync_empty_title: Connect a system to import its history
sync_empty_description: Connect Shopify, JTL or Cin7 and Luma imports orders, fulfillments, products, stock, and the customers you allow, then keeps them up to date.
sync_footnote: Syncing only reads data. Luma never changes records in your systems while it syncs. Most changes arrive within seconds, but a busy system can delay them. Luma also checks for changes every few minutes and rereads all records once a day.
sync_connection_inactive: Syncing pauses while the connection isn’t active. Records already imported stay in Luma.

sync_links_load_failed: Luma couldn’t load the linked sources.
sync_links_request_failed: Luma couldn’t send this request. Try again.
sync_links_description_order: Each source keeps its own lines, shipments and evidence. Enabled automatic rules link unambiguous order references. Review remaining suggestions before linking them.
sync_links_description_sku: Each source keeps its own ID and data. Enabled automatic rules link unique matching SKU codes with compatible units and product names. Review remaining suggestions before linking them.
sync_links_description_location: Each source keeps its own ID. Luma treats records from different sources as the same location only after a person links them.
sync_links_suggestions_ambiguous: More than one order shares this reference. Check each source record before choosing.
sync_links_linking_order: Linking records. Luma is updating the order and its source records.
sync_links_linking_sku: Linking records. Luma is regrouping stock, products, and order lines.
sync_links_unlinking_order: Unlinking records. Luma is updating the order and its source records.
sync_links_unlinking_sku: Unlinking records. Luma is regrouping stock, products, and order lines.
sync_links_link_order_description: Both source versions will appear on this order. Lines and shipments stay separate, and earlier links and evidence stay available. You can unlink later.
sync_links_unlink_order_description: This source becomes a separate order again, with its own lines and shipments. Luma records the change and your reason.
sync_links_link_sku_description: Luma will treat both records as one SKU. Stock, products, and order lines from each source are grouped here, and each source keeps its own quantities. You can unlink later. Luma records the change.
sync_links_unlink_sku_description: This source becomes its own SKU again. Its stock, products, and order lines move with it. Luma records the change.
sync_links_link_location_description: Luma will treat both records as one location. Stock from each source is grouped here, and each source keeps its own quantities. You can unlink later. Luma records the change.
sync_links_unlink_location_description: This source becomes its own location again. Its stock moves with it. Luma records the change.
sync_autolink_load_failed: Luma couldn’t load the automatic linking rules.
sync_autolink_description: With one Shopify store, Luma automatically links unique SKU codes and explicit order references from your ERP and shipping system. Preview matches, review conflicts or disable a rule here.
sync_autolink_applied: {count, plural, one {{count, number} link applied} other {{count, number} links applied}}
sync_autolink_empty: No automatic linking rules. Matching records stay separate until you link them or enable a rule.
sync_autolink_editor_description: Preview the current matches, then enable the rule to keep linking new matches with your access. Disabling a rule keeps the links already applied.
sync_autolink_rule_sku: SKU codes match regardless of letter case and surrounding spaces. Each code must be unique in both connections, and the units must match. Records someone separated manually are skipped.
sync_autolink_rule_order: The external order reference in the ERP must match exactly one order number in this Shopify store. Dates, totals and customer details aren’t enough to link orders. Records someone separated manually are skipped.
sync_autolink_preview_eligible: {count, plural, one {{count, number} match can be linked} other {{count, number} matches can be linked}}
sync_autolink_preview_skipped: {ambiguous, number} ambiguous · {conflict, number} conflicting · {excluded, number} separated manually or awaiting review · {stale, number} with outdated or missing data
sync_autolink_preview_note: Luma checks future matches again before linking them. Each source keeps its own quantities, prices and order states.
sync_autolink_error_role: Your role no longer includes Manage imports.
sync_autolink_error_conflict: This rule changed or already exists. Close this dialog and refresh the page before trying again.
sync_autolink_error_save: Luma couldn’t update automatic linking. Try again.
sync_note_retired: Confirmed deleted or disconnected: {records}. Current views exclude these source facts; their evidence is kept.
sync_links_description_line: Confirm the same order item in another source. Lines must belong to this linked order and use compatible quantity units. Luma never matches lines by SKU text alone.
sync_links_suggestions_line: Lines in other sources of this order
sync_links_candidate_line: Another source line in this linked order
sync_links_linking_line: Matching lines. Luma is refreshing the order and its fulfillment evidence.
sync_links_unlinking_line: Separating lines. Luma is refreshing the order and its fulfillment evidence.
sync_links_link_line_description: Confirm that these source lines represent the same item in this order. Each source keeps its quantities and shipment evidence. This match can affect which changes Luma can run. Luma records your reason; you can unlink later.
sync_links_unlink_line_description: This source line becomes a separate item in the same order. Luma may be unable to run changes until the line is matched again. Luma records the change and your reason.
sync_link_coverage_sku: {linked} of {total} SKU records linked across systems
sync_link_coverage_order: {linked} of {total} order records linked across systems
sync_link_coverage_monitoring: Linked SKUs support stock comparisons once locations are linked and source reads are current. Unlinked records are not compared.

sync_wait_admission_unavailable: Read scheduling is temporarily unavailable. Luma retries automatically.
sync_wait_provider_cooldown: The source’s request limit has been reached. Luma will retry automatically.

sync_wait_worker_capacity: Waiting for sync capacity. Other reads are running.
